institutionName: UiT The Arctic University of Norway

questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Academic opportunities

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I was interested in Sami perspectives on health, I originally wanted to explore whether or not I wanted to dive into that field within public health when finishing my masters degree. And I have a Norwegian family, so I wanted to explore more about Norway.

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I think the program was amazing but UIT's administration is a mess. It seemed like the contact person at UIT left for a extended vacation for several months leading up to the exchange.

questions.question: How easy was it to find the information you needed to know upon arrival? *
questions.answer: I liked that the erasmus program had introductory programs for us. I am fluent in Norwegian so I found the UIT's website easy to navigate.

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: The erasmus had introductory days at the university.

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing through my host institution

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: super easy, the samshipnaden website is easy to navigate.

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: That they are expected to have their own cookware

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: Yes, I thought the pricing, availability and proximity to uni was great

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: There is a lot of steps

questions.question: Please describe the registration process at your host institution *
questions.answer: I had to contact the professors via uit-studentsupport to get into the courses i wanted, as the sourcecatalog did not reflect the courses that they actually offering

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: I contacted the uit-studentsupport and got transferred to several people who helped me out

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: I got some of them, a lot of the courses were not available for any students although they were in the catalog

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Contact them night and day in order to get accepted to courses, you need to be proactive

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I liked the courses that I was accepted to, I think I learned a lot from being in a niche international student environment

questions.question: Were you a BA or MA student at UCPH when you were on exchange? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Did you take BA or MA courses at your host university? *
questions.answer: MA

questions.question: Please elaborate on the level of courses *
questions.answer: the level was equivalent, they might have been able to raise it a bit if anything

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: it is the same, danish and Norwegian academics do not seem to be too different

questions.question: How long were you on exchange? *
questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the non-academic opportunities (clubs, sports, etc.) at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: I loved that we were invited to voluntary conferences

questions.question: What kinds of cultural, athletic and social activities were available for students at your host institution? *
questions.answer: I attended several activities at the sami week, I went  skiing mulipel times a week , and joined the knitting club at uni

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: I would recommend pepole to attend the sami week, go skiing, sailing  and hiking

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: I would recommend people to go skiing and go for hikes

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: super easy, I got a lot of Norwegian friends that I am still in contact with to this day

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
questions.answer: Be social and take initiative, Norwegians are easier to get to know if you are doing a activity together so join a social club

questions.question: What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: non, but I do also have Norwegian family

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: I like how outdoorsy Norwegians are

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: I don't think you can not go to Tromsø without being sporty. Be ready to say yes to new opportunities. Appreciate the nature, you will not find anywhere nearly as beautiful.

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: Bring hiking shoes and spikes, it is slippery.

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: Taking the courses and meeting new people.

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: UIT administration in tems of courses

questions.question: Any other comments?
Do you agree to share your travel report with other fellow students? *
questions.answer: Yes
